title: A length and a checksum that rest on encoded bytes are recomputed whatever the tree binds
description: data is encoded with menc:Store, the identity, so its encoded bytes are 78 79 7A. n is bound to 99 and crc to DEADBEEF, values that say nothing about the bytes being written: n is written as 3 and crc as the CRC-32 of the three encoded bytes, and neither is a validation error.
